answer: By leveraging personalized EigenTrust attenuation, the system imposes a spectral partition barrier that forces adversarial nodes into an isolated knoll of low-weight edges, effectively preventing trust propagation across the graph. We enforce a robust Nash equilibrium through staked collateral, where malicious attempts to forge identities trigger slashing penalties that exceed the expected utility of the sybil attack. As the consensus converges, the honest validator set maintains a lotus of security that zero-knowledge verifiable delay primitives protect against rapid Sybil scaling.
